payload.title: The Dataset class
payload.description: This Jupyter notebook provides a tutorial on editing and creating LiPD files using the PyLiPD library in Python. It focuses on the Dataset class, which is central to manipulating paleoclimate datasets. The notebook demonstrates how to load LiPD files, convert them into Dataset objects, and access various properties and data using Python APIs. It also covers working with age ensembles and understanding the relationships among classes derived from the LinkedEarth Ontology.
